framework: NVIDIA NeMo / Megatron-Bridge recipe of the MLPerf Training v6.1 release 20261012, unmodified, on NVIDIA NGC PyTorch 26.09

container.base_image: nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.09-py3 (the Dockerfile's FROM_IMAGE_NAME default; pinned for a rebuild as nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.09-py3@sha256:6e8ccc607fc2a51e3741667b86316a0889418ba8b78ed0ba96e8d282b648a7a6)
container.build_args: setup.sh in this directory passes FROM_IMAGE_NAME (the pinned base), MBRIDGE_REVISION=ea5dded83078cf7e61ef91960273053cf564d5ac and TE_REVISION=5e52befd5262c06289106338c308079d6adb391f (the commits the image that ran recorded; DeepEP is pinned by commit in the Dockerfile), and fails after the build unless the image holds the commits of the image that ran
container.image_that_ran: NVIDIA's build of this Dockerfile, squashfs sha256 3b3a1c6669bb3cf25bc5027d01b101d9673c30c169d8d354f0653f38831397a6, 25965891584 bytes
container.public_rebuild: not run (open by decision); the image's recipe directory and commit records were read from the squashfs (README.md, The image that produced the results)

config_file: config_GB300_2x4x3xtp1pp1cp1ep1_mxfp8.sh (NVIDIA's GB300 2-node config from the 20261012 image, unchanged)
custom_kernels: none added by Firmus; NVIDIA's recipe includes its fused QK-norm + RoPE kernel (opt_kernels/, on by default)
launcher: implementations/nemo_g1_1012/run.sub (differences from NVIDIA's run.sub: run.sub.vs_nvidia1012.diff in this directory)
